content.text:
context.template(text(pair[1]),'event/%d/h/%d/v'%(index,j))))
            row['fields'] = fields
        elif kind=='data':
            row['data'] = context.template(text(record['data']),'event/%d/data'%index)
        events.append(row)

    channels = sequence(document['channels'],MAX_CHANNELS)
    channel_names = set()
    compiled_channels = []
    for index,channel in enumerate(channels):
        exact(channel,['name','parts'])
        name = text(channel['name'],32)
        if NAME.fullmatch(name) is None or name in channel_names:
            raise ValueError('channel name')
        channel_names.add(name)
        parts = sequence(channel['parts'],MAX_BUDGET)
        budget += len(parts)
        out_parts = []
        for j,part in enumerate(parts):
            exact(part,['case','data'])
            owner = part['case']
            if owner is not None and (type(owner) is not str or owner not in names):
                raise ValueError('owner label')
            out_parts.append({'case':owner,
                              'data':context.template(text(part['data']),
                                                       'channel/%d/part/%d/data'%(index,j))})
